     // Helper function to safely parse and split range strings (e.g., "date1 to date2" or "date1 - date2")
     function parseDateString(text) {
         // Split by common range indicators if present
         const parts = text.split(/\s+(?:to|-)\s+/i);
         return parts.map(p => new Date(p.trim()));
     }

     // --- Basic Date & Time Formatting ---
     function formatBasicDatesAndTimes() {
         var eventDates = document.querySelectorAll('.piecal_date-only:not([data-formatted])');
         eventDates.forEach(function(element) {
             var targetElement = element.childElementCount > 0 ? element.children[0] : element;

             if (dates.length > 0 && dates.every(d => !isNaN(d))) {
                 var options = { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric' };

                 targetElement.textContent = dates.map(d => d.toLocaleDateString(undefined, options)).join(' - ');
                 element.setAttribute('data-formatted', 'true');
             }
         });

         var eventTimes = document.querySelectorAll('.piecal_time-only:not([data-formatted])');
         eventTimes.forEach(function(element) {
             var targetElement = element.childElementCount > 0 ? element.children[0] : element;

                 targetElement.textContent = dates.map(d => d.toLocaleTimeString(undefined, options)).join(' - ');

</div><h2 class="brxe-jsuluf brxe-heading toc-ignore" id="get-funded-with-spacewerx-powering-space-dominance-through-innovation">Get Funded with SpaceWERX: Powering Space Dominance Through Innovation</h2></div></div></div><section id="brxe-nlvxnb" class="brxe-section"><div id="brxe-ahaocd" class="brxe-container"><h2 id="brxe-sgacpu" class="brxe-heading afw-v2-section-heading">Open Funding Opportunities</h2><div id="brxe-xgrkcb" class="brxe-text"><p style="text-align: center;">Discover how your small business can partner with SpaceWERX to solve critical challenges.</p>
</div><div id="brxe-vmypav" class="brxe-block brx-grid"><div id="brxe-eoxulv" class="brxe-text-basic">Upcoming<br>Solicitations</div><div id="brxe-ogdrti" class="brxe-text-basic">Pre-Release</div><div id="brxe-cajofw" class="brxe-text-basic">Open</div><div id="brxe-zustod" class="brxe-text-basic">Close</div></div><!--brx-loop-start-eotflq--><div class="brxe-eotflq brxe-block"><div class="brxe-ycdphz brxe-block"><a class="brxe-zqhodj brxe-text-basic" href="https://spacewerx.us/accelerate/stratfi-tacfi/#:~:text=21%20Space%20TACFI-,Resources,-PY26.1%20SBIR/STTR" data-brx-anchor="true">PY26.2 TACFI Notice of Opportunity</a></div><div class="brxe-pejvda brxe-block"><div class="brxe-sarakz brxe-text-basic">N/A</div></div><div class="brxe-cvcnpj brxe-block"><div class="brxe-datufv brxe-text-basic">5 JUN 26</div></div><div class="brxe-wsiwom brxe-block"><div class="brxe-lhacsx brxe-text-basic">Accepting Submissions on a Continuous Basis</div></div></div><!--brx-loop-start-tjgsbl--><div class="brxe-tjgsbl brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><div class="brxe-lpynhg brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><a class="brxe-rmfkec brxe-text-basic" href="https://spacewerx.us/accelerate/stratfi-tacfi/#:~:text=21%20Space%20TACFI-,Resources,-PY26.1%20SBIR/STTR" data-brx-anchor="true"><strong>SOLICITATION</strong>: PY26.2 TACFI Notice of Opportunity</a><div class="brxe-elpopu brxe-text"><p><strong>PRE-RELEASE</strong>: N/A<br><strong>OPEN</strong>: 5 JUN 26<br><strong>CLOSE</strong>: Accepting Submissions on a Continuous Basis</p>
</div></div></div><!--brx-loop-start-xeeugx--><!--brx-loop-start-ldkaby--><!--brx-loop-start-whshrd--><!--brx-loop-start-ojzuzx--><!--brx-loop-start-btypgh--><!--brx-loop-start-srinpr--><div id="brxe-dqcxie" class="brxe-block"><div class="brxe-text"><p>Dates subject to change</p>
</div><a id="brxe-zudmvr" class="brxe-button btn bricks-button md bricks-background-primary" href="https://www.dodsbirsttr.mil/submissions/solicitation-documents/active-solicitations" target="_blank" aria-describedby="brx-new-tab-link-description">View All DoW Active Solicitations</a></div></div></section><section id="brxe-cdaxqp" class="brxe-section"><div id="brxe-octmqb" class="brxe-container"><h2 class="brxe-heading afw-v2-section-heading" id="understanding-sbir-sttr">Understanding SBIR/STTR</h2><div class="brxe-text"><p class="p1" style="text-align: center;">The SBIR and STTR programs are key federal initiatives designed to harness the power of small businesses and research institutions for cutting-edge innovation. Through these programs, SpaceWERX awards contracts to drive the development of technologies with both military and commercial potential.</p>
</div><div id="brxe-bjryos" class="brxe-block brx-grid bricks-lazy-hidden"><div id="brxe-kfdbra" class="brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 id="brxe-xubhwv" class="brxe-heading">What are the key differences?</h3><div id="brxe-uzmsfh" class="brxe-text"><ul>
<li><strong>Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR)</strong>: Established in 1982, SBIR funds research and development (R&D) conducted by <strong>small businesses</strong> (500 or fewer employees).</li>
<li><strong>Small Business Technology Transfer (STTR)</strong>: Established in 1992, STTR funds <strong>cooperative R&D projects</strong> between small businesses and <strong>non-profit U.S. research institutions</strong> (like universities).</li>
</ul>
<p>Both programs aim to transition promising commercial technologies into operational use for the U.S. Space Force, administered in partnership with the <a href="https://www.sbir.gov/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Small Business Administration</a>.</p>
</div></div><div id="brxe-oaltti" class="brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 id="brxe-tcbgiz" class="brxe-heading">The SpaceWERX Funding Process</h3><div id="brxe-qgfceb" class="brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><img src="data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg%20xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%20viewBox='0%200%201%201'%3E%3C/svg%3E" class="brxe-image css-filter size-full bricks-lazy-hidden" alt="" id="brxe-eqepvh" decoding="async" data-src="https://spacewerx.us/wp-content/uploads/FundingPath-Web-Icon-1.svg" data-type="string"><div id="brxe-yltcxe" class="brxe-text-basic">Find the Right Funding Path for Your Innovation at SpaceWERX.</div></div><div id="brxe-meawox" class="brxe-text"><p>SpaceWERX offers tailored SBIR/STTR funding opportunities to help small businesses and research institutions develop and transition innovative technologies for the U.S. Space Force.</p>
</div></div></div><div data-script-id="bdudmp" class="brxe-video"><iframe loading="lazy" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; fullscreen; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" referrerpolicy="strict-origin-when-cross-origin" title="SBIR STTR for Small Business Video" data-src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/fUChUAmpLaw?wmode=opaque&rel=0&enablejsapi=1&origin=https%3A%2F%2Fspacewerx.us&iv_load_policy=3" class="bricks-lazy-hidden"></iframe></div></div></section><section id="brxe-tcxgeu" class="brxe-section bricks-lazy-hidden"><div class="brxe-container bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 id="brxe-vbydtq" class="brxe-heading">Funding Avenues by Phase of Development</h3><div id="brxe-xglzaf" class="brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><!--brx-loop-start-gicnxg--><div class="brxe-gicnxg brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 class="brxe-ypkrwz brxe-heading">Phase I: Feasibility Study</h3><div class="brxe-bhqonn brxe-text"><p style="text-align: center;">Prove the technical merit and commercial viability of your innovative idea. For Specific Topic efforts, this is a technical feasibility study. For Open Topic, it also includes a critical customer discovery phase.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>KEY DETAILS</strong>:<br>
<strong>Funding</strong>: $75K-$180K<br>
<strong>Duration</strong>: 3-12 months<br>
<strong>Outcome</strong>: Prove concept and potential</p>
</div></div><div class="brxe-gicnxg brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 class="brxe-ypkrwz brxe-heading">Phase II: Prototype Development</h3><div class="brxe-bhqonn brxe-text"><p style="text-align: center;">Develop a working prototype and further mature your technology, typically requiring a USSF customer. This can be done either by advancing a successful Phase I project or by applying for a Direct to Phase II (D2P2) award.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>KEY DETAILS</strong>:<br>
<span style="text-decoration: underline;">FUNDING</span><strong><br>
</strong>$1.25M-$1.8M</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">Duration</span><strong><br>
</strong>Up to 24 months</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">REQUIREMENT<br>
</span><strong>(Open Topic Only)<br>
</strong>USSF Customer Memorandum for both Follow-On Phase IIs and D2P2 applicants.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Direct to Phase II (D2P2)<br>
</strong>This pathway allows qualified small businesses to start with a Phase II. A signed Customer Memorandum is only required for an Open Topic D2P2 as Specific Topics have a pre-identified customer.</p>
</div></div><div class="brxe-gicnxg brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 class="brxe-ypkrwz brxe-heading">STRATFI / TACFI: Growth Stage Investment</h3><div class="brxe-bhqonn brxe-text"><p style="text-align: center;">Bridge the gap between early development and full commercialization. These programs provide significant funding to scale promising technologies.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>KEY DETAILS</strong>:<br>
<strong>Purpose<br>
</strong>Scale technology and achieve transition.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Eligibility<br>
</strong>For successful Phase II projects (within 2 years).</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">KEY FEATURE</span><strong><br>
</strong>Requires matching funds from government, private investment, or a combination of both sources.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><span style="text-decoration: underline;">FUNDING</span><strong><br>
Strategic Funding Increase (STRATFI)<br>
</strong>$6M-$45M for strategic, high-impact capabilities.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Tactical Funding Increase (TACFI)<br>
</strong>$375K-$2M for tactical innovation and rapid transition.</p>
</div><a class="brxe-linkkw brxe-button afw-v2-btn bricks-button" href="https://spacewerx.us/accelerate/stratfi-tacfi/" aria-label="Click here to learn more">Learn More</a></div><div class="brxe-gicnxg brxe-block bricks-lazy-hidden"><h3 class="brxe-ypkrwz brxe-heading">Phase III: Commercialization</h3><div class="brxe-bhqonn brxe-text"><p style="text-align: center;">Transition your technology to operational use for the USSF or into the commercial market, funded by non-SBIR/STTR sources.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>KEY DETAILS</strong>:<br>
